title: You're Not Ready for Evil Martin (feat. wintrcat)
summary: Debut of Evil Martin, a custom bot by programmer wintrcat: it plays like (sleepy-looking) Martin until the engine evaluation reaches -6 against it, then 'unleashes his fury' and plays like a grandmaster (~3000) for the rest of the game, with its icon changing (viewers see it, the player doesn't). The creator plays the London, nervously accepts free pieces, realises from a sharp rook move that the GM mode has triggered, defends a bishop-pair attack, trades rooks, promotes and mates (avoiding stalemate) - won on the first try.
rules: Opponent plays at Martin (250) strength while its eval is above -6.
When eval reaches -6 (from Evil Martin's side) it permanently switches to GM/max strength for the rest of the game; avatar/name changes from Sleepy Martin (250) to Evil Martin (3000).
The trigger moment is not announced to the player.

opponent.name: Sleepy Martin (250) -> Evil Martin (3000)
opponent.avatar_description: Before trigger: Martin cartoon looking asleep ('he just looks well asleep'). After: bearded Martin with glowing red eyes, angled eyebrows and an evil grin, red sweater (thumbnail 'new bot'). Remake as an original red-eyed bearded cartoon.
